fees_accumulated.meaning: A BuilderWallet holds accumulated builder fees.
fees_accumulated.evidence: since there is no guards on `BuilderWallet.init`, anyone can call it and overwrite the `builderAdmin` address, which is used to guard `sweep` from being called by anyone. In practice, any builder fees accumulated in these wallets can be stolen because of that.

preconditions.text: A BuilderWallet holds accumulated builder fees, and builderAdmin is the value guarding sweep.
preconditions.derivation: Conjunction of the two supplied preconditions.
evidence: since there is no guards on `BuilderWallet.init`, anyone can call it and overwrite the `builderAdmin` address, which is used to guard `sweep` from being called by anyone. In practice, any builder fees accumulated in these wallets can be stolen because of that.

safety.text: builderAdmin should not be overwritten by an arbitrary caller, and if sweep is called it should be by the legitimate builderAdmin.
safety.derivation: From the intent that init be guarded and sweep stay limited to the legitimate builderAdmin.
evidence: since there is no guards on `BuilderWallet.init`, anyone can call it and overwrite the `builderAdmin` address, which is used to guard `sweep` from being called by anyone. In practice, any builder fees accumulated in these wallets can be stolen because of that.

effects.text: Builder fees accumulated in the wallet can be stolen by the attacker.
effects.derivation: Impact downstream of the overwrite; does not itself witness NOT safety.

effect_coverage.reason: Outcome expressible as a boolean, but amount, transfer and victim are unstated.

assumptions: The wallet holds accumulated builder fees as supplied; no amount is given.
builderAdmin is the sole guard on sweep; no other guard is stated.
An arbitrary caller can invoke init and set a caller-controlled builderAdmin.
unresolved: Whether init is intended as single-call or restricted to a specific caller.
Whether the wallet must be uninitialized for the overwrite.
Whether sweep has additional guards beyond builderAdmin.
Which wallets or amounts are at stake; no transfer is demonstrated.

limitations: Theft amount, victim and actual transfer are asserted only as possible.
The aggregate user/builder loss claim is economic and deferred out of core scope.
V (fees stolen) does not by itself witness NOT safety; recorded as mismatch.
Addresses support identity only; ownership/value relations are not modeled.
Root cause (no guard) is not a precondition source and appears only via assumptions.
